description: This file defines the XColorResourceManager class, which manages localization and retrieval of known color information, including color names and ARGB values, within the PdfSharp library for PDF processing.

classes.name: XColorResourceManager
classes.description: A class that manages localization and access to known color information, such as translating color names based on culture and retrieving color details based on ARGB values.

methods.name: XColorResourceManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resource manager with the current UI culture or a specified CultureInfo.

methods.name: XColorResourceManager.ToColorName
methods.description: Converts a known color or an ARGB color to its localized name, depending on the culture.

methods.name: XColorResourceManager.GetKnownColors
methods.description: Retrieves all known colors, optionally including transparent.

methods.name: XColorResourceManager.GetKnownColor
methods.description: Returns the known color enum corresponding to a given ARGB value, throwing an exception if not known.
